title: From Schrodinger Bridge to Optimal Transport over Sub-Riemannian Manifolds
tldr_zh: 沿控制方向加噪声定义退化 SB：bracket-generating 下适定、强对偶，ε→0 收敛到 sub-Riemannian OT
tldr_en: Noise only along control directions yields a well-posed hypoelliptic SB under bracket-generating assumptions; strong duality and convergence to sub-Riemannian OT as noise vanishes.
key_numbers: No quantitative results; single 3D Heisenberg-group example (alpha=1/4) with eps in {1,0.5,0.1,0.01} (Figs. 3-4)
